_comment: FULL SCALE - real PA6GF30 scanner geometry at the real specimen size (820x600x600, 832 projections over 360 deg, 1720x1070 detector, magnification 11.919 so one detector pixel is one voxel at isocentre). Fibres are radius 3 so they are cleanly resolved, and num_filaments is calibrated to ~15.5 vol% to match the PA6GF30 datasheet. Projections are ~6 GB per set; expect ~27 GB total with TIFF stacks.
_defect_params_note: NOT USED. defect_type is 'none', so none of the *_params blocks below are read. They are templates: set defect_type to 'hole', 'square_notch', 'double_square_notch', 'v_notch', 'double_v_notch' or 'reduced' and the matching block is applied automatically. WARNING: hole_params and reduced_params are scaled for this 820x600x600 specimen, but square_notch_params and v_notch_params still carry values from a 256^3 pilot - their coordinates would place the notch near the bottom of the specimen and far too small. Rescale them before enabling either notch type.
